import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for pair in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    di=np.array(G[pair+' input']); do=np.array(G[pair+' output'])
    H,W=di.shape
    seeds=[(i,j,int(di[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if di[i,j] not in (0,1)]
    ch=[(i,j,int(do[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if di[i,j]==1 and do[i,j]!=1]
    print(pair,'seeds',seeds,'nchg',len(ch))
    # nearest-seed color prediction vs actual
    mis=[]
    for i,j,c in ch:
        ds=sorted((max(abs(i-si),abs(j-sj)),s) for si,sj,_ in seeds)
        pred=max(seeds,key=lambda s:(abs(i-s[0])+abs(j-s[1]),-s[2]))[2]
        if pred!=c: mis.append((i,j,c,pred,ds[:3]))
    print('mismatch nearest-manchattan:',mis[:5])

def f(a):

    vals,counts=np.unique(g, return_counts=True)
    bg=0
    main=vals[np.argmax(counts)]
    others=[int(v) for v in vals if v not in (bg,main)]
    if not others: return [list(r) for r in g]
    out=g.copy()
    # stray cells: singletons of any other color? or any non-main cell whose value differs from main.
    # recolor each such cell to main color
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and g[i,j]!=main:
                out[i,j]=main
    # crop to bbox of non-bg after recoloring
    m=(out!=bg)
    if not m.any(): return a
    r0,r1=m.any(1).sum()>0...

    r0,r1,cc0,cc1=int(rs.min()),int(rs.max()),int(cs.min()),int(cs.max())
    return [[int(x) for x in row[cc0:cc1+1]] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
